ig:
How much alcohol for a 20-person holiday party? 🎄

The bartender rule: 2 drinks per guest the first hour, 1 per hour after that.
20 guests × 4 hours = 100 drinks.

• 750 ml bottle ≈ 16 cocktails
• 750 ml wine ≈ 5 glasses
• Ice: 20–40 lb
